judgment.rationale: The existing screenshot and diagnostic ZIP establish a real stuck/modifier-suppression symptom, and the settings point to Win-mode Grab and Move while elevated. They still do not identify the foreground game/app, window mode, focus transition, or recovery boundary needed to distinguish known Grab and Move modifier-interference issues from a new hook-state bug.
evidence: The report says fullscreen games are a usual context and that Alt+Tab, Win+Space, and a single Win press fail while the foreground window is active.
The online keyboard tester screenshot shows key-up events while key-down is no longer detected.
The attached diagnostic ZIP shows PowerToys v0.100.2 running elevated with GrabAndMove enabled.
GrabAndMove/settings.json sets modifierKey=1, so Win is the configured activation modifier; excluded apps include cs2.exe, victoria3.exe, and Terraria.exe.
GrabAndMove main.cpp uses low-level keyboard and mouse hooks with absorbed/replayed modifier state, pending click state, foreground exclusion, and a WinEvent foreground-change reset path.
Related open issues 47337 and 47802 cover Grab and Move suppressing keyboard shortcuts, and 49704 covers Win modifier Start-menu behavior, but none exactly proves this foreground-only softlock.
judgment.recommended_action: Acknowledge the supplied ZIP and ask for the exact app/window mode, focus and input sequence, active modifier/settings, and which recovery action restores key-down; do not request a replacement ZIP unless settings changed or maintainers need fresh logs.

issue_context.summary: Grab and Move intermittently leaves Alt and Win shortcuts unusable only in certain foreground contexts, with key-up still observed and normal behavior returning outside that context.
known_information: The report includes a screenshot and PowerToysReport_2026-08-30-16-52-52.zip.
PowerToys v0.100.2 is running elevated on Windows 11 24H2.
Grab and Move is enabled and configured for the Win modifier, with Alt absorption still enabled in settings.
The reporter lists excluded apps cs2.exe, victoria3.exe, and Terraria.exe in the diagnostic settings.
No comments, assignee, linked fix, or exact foreground application are present on the upstream issue.
inferences: A stale absorbed/replayed modifier or foreground hook-state transition is plausible, but current evidence does not establish which path loses the key-down.
Because desktop interaction restores shortcuts, the problem may depend on the foreground app/window mode rather than a globally stuck physical key.
The report overlaps prior Grab and Move shortcut-interference threads but contains enough foreground/fullscreen and Win-mode detail to avoid closing it as a simple duplicate today.
issue_context.analysis: The diagnostic archive is useful and changes the request: maintainers should not ask generically for another bug report. The missing decision-changing evidence is occurrence-specific context that can be tied back to the hook state machine: app identity, exclusive/borderless/windowed mode, whether the Win modifier was held during focus changes, and whether module disable/PowerToys exit clears the condition.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body, labels, assignees, project items, timeline, screenshot link, and diagnostic ZIP.
Inspected extracted global settings and GrabAndMove/settings.json from the ZIP: v0.100.2, elevated/run_elevated true, GrabAndMove enabled, modifierKey=1, and excluded games listed.
Inspected src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp hook state: Win/Alt absorption, pending click replay, foreground-change reset, excluded-app bypass, and held-key tracking.
Reviewed related issues 47337, 47802, and 49704; they provide context but do not resolve this exact foreground softlock report.

comment.body: Thanks for the 0.100.2 report, screenshot, and attached PowerToysReport. The ZIP is useful: it shows Grab and Move enabled, PowerToys running elevated, and the activation modifier set to Win. The remaining ambiguity is which foreground program/window mode and exact input transition leave Win or Alt key-down suppressed. On the next occurrence, please name the game or app, state whether it is exclusive full screen, borderless full screen, or windowed, confirm the current Grab and Move modifier/settings, describe whether the modifier was held during a mouse action or focus change, and report whether switching to the desktop, disabling Grab and Move, exiting PowerToys, or restarting the foreground app restores input. A replacement ZIP is not needed unless those settings changed.
